units.source_text: 诗中关于佛道修行方面，措辞很谦逊。

en.t: In the poem, his words about Buddhist practice were very humble.

units.source_text: 因此冷泉院看了答诗想道：“八亲王对尘世还有留恋呢。”

en.t: So when Reizei-in read the reply poem, he thought, "The Eighth Prince still has some attachment to this world."

units.source_text: 很可怜他。

en.t: He felt great pity for him.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨将中将薰君道心甚深之事告诉八亲王，说道：

en.t: The Ajari told the Eighth Prince that Captain Kaoru had a very deep religious aspiration, and said:

units.source_text: “薰中将对我说：‘我从小就深盼学得经文教义。

en.t: "Captain Kaoru said to me, 'Ever since childhood I have deeply wished to learn the scriptures and their teachings.

units.source_text: 只因尘缘难绝，蹉跎至今。

en.t: But because worldly ties were hard to sever, I have let the time slip by until now.

units.source_text: 其间为了公务私事，奔走忙碌，日复一日。

en.t: All the while, I have been running about busily for official duties and private affairs, day after day.

units.source_text: 此身本来微不足道，即使立志笼闭深山，专心习诵经文，亦可毫无顾虑。

en.t: This body of mine is of little consequence, so even if I resolved to shut myself away deep in the mountains and devote myself to studying and reciting the scriptures, I would have nothing to worry about.

units.source_text: 然而总是踌躇不决，因循度日。

en.t: Yet I have always hesitated, unable to decide, and have merely drifted through the days.

units.source_text: 今闻皇叔如此勇猛精进，心甚向往，定当前来请教。’

en.t: Now that I hear the imperial uncle is practicing with such vigorous devotion, I feel great longing and will certainly come to seek instruction.'

units.source_text: 他托我传言，意极诚恳。”

en.t: He entrusted me with this message, and his feeling was extremely sincere."

units.source_text: 八亲王答道：“大凡觉悟人世无常而心生厌弃，皆因自身遭逢忧患，

en.t: The Eighth Prince replied, "In general, when people awaken to the impermanence of human life and come to loathe it, it is because they themselves have met with sorrow and trouble.

units.source_text: 故而顿觉举世皆可痛恨，即以此为起点，发生学道之心。

en.t: For that reason they suddenly feel that the whole world is hateful, and from that starting point the wish to study the Way arises.

units.source_text: 今薰中将年方青春，诸事如意称心，毫无不足之憾，

en.t: But Captain Kaoru is now in the bloom of youth, with everything going as he wishes and no cause for dissatisfaction at all.

units.source_text: 而早就发心学佛以修后世，真乃难能可贵之事。

en.t: For him to have formed the resolve so early to study Buddhism and cultivate merit for the life to come is truly rare and admirable.

units.source_text: 像我这样的人，因宿命注定，只觉人世可厌，

en.t: Someone like me, bound by fate, only feels that this human world is hateful.

units.source_text: 就特别容易受佛劝导，自然能遂静修之愿。

en.t: For that very reason I am especially easily guided by the Buddha's teaching, and can naturally fulfill my wish for quiet religious practice.

units.source_text: 然而我生余年不多，深恐未得大觉大悟，

en.t: Yet I have few years left to live, and I deeply fear that I may never attain true awakening.

units.source_text: 一生便尔告终，于是前世后世两无着落，深可慨耳。

en.t: If my life simply comes to an end like this, then both my past and future lives will be left without any sure footing, which is deeply lamentable.

units.source_text: 故中将欲向我请教，则我岂敢！

en.t: So if the Captain wishes to seek instruction from me, how could I dare accept such a role!

units.source_text: 我当视彼为先悟之法友可也。”

en.t: I should instead regard him as a companion in the Dharma who has awakened before me."

units.source_text: 此后两人互通音信，薰君就亲来访问。

en.t: After this, the two exchanged messages, and Lord Kaoru eventually came to visit in person.
